cards.mood: The piece opens with a serene, contemplative atmosphere evoking vastness and history, gradually building tension through layered instrumentation.
cards.vocal: Singer A (Male) possesses a clear, resonant tenor voice with a warm, storytelling quality in the verses that transforms into a powerful, belting delivery in the choruses.
cards.palette: A traditional Chinese bamboo flute (Dizi) carries the main melodic motif in the intro and verses, later joined by a sweeping string section that takes over the primary harmonic drive in the choruses.
